findings.title: Discount formula inverted multiplies price by percent
findings.explanation: New implementation does `amount * rate` where rate is percent e.g. 10. For price 100 and 10% off this returns 1000 instead of 90. Correct is `amount * (1 - pct/100)`. Logic is inverted and missing /100 scaling.

evidence.why: New code returns amount * rate instead of discounted amount

findings.title: Float conversion loses money precision and Decimal type
findings.explanation: Replaces to_money/Decimal/quantize with float(). This breaks Decimal return contract, loses cents rounding, and introduces binary float errors for money. e.g. 0.1+0.2 style errors in pricing.

evidence.why: Uses float() and returns float, drops to_money and quantize

findings.suggestion: Restore to_money(price) and quantize() and return Decimal.

findings.title: Removed percent range validation allows invalid discounts
findings.explanation: Removed ValueError for percent out of 0-100. Now negative or >100 percents silently produce nonsense e.g. -10 gives negative total, 200 gives 2x price, previously rejected.

evidence.why: Range check pct<0 or pct>100 was deleted with no replacement

findings.suggestion: Re-add: if pct<0 or pct>100: raise ValueError
